answer: My answer to sybils is Vested mail sorter certificate with postal workers attestation — a certificate workers renew after sort audits — which makes the signal of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Fakes fail here because a certificate workers renew after sort audits is tied to something outside the network; the opal of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the pearl of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
